description: fnpf_2d_6dof_box (floating box in regular waves, surge, heave and pitch free) with the theta-Robin time integration (A 310 5, REEFMG) at the RK3 step of N 47 0.75: the body integrated with Heun (rk2), the loads at t^n and of the first corrector state, the footprint columns Dirichlet in the Robin system.
covers: fnpf_theta with fnpf_6DOF: stage 0 and 1, solve_pre/solve_post, footprint_mask
